column2:
A small, brave tabby cat full of energy.
No weapon, no armor - just quick paws
and a fearless pounce.
Small enough to slip past danger, light enough to leap high.

A fluffy, cloud-white visitor from somewhere far away.
Its arms and legs stretch farther than you think,
and it bounces off what it stomps on.
Nobody knows where it came from.
To you who ran the final road.\nThey're now available in Character Select.
